st_trouvailles.name: Rue des Trouvailles
st_trouvailles.alt: Inside a sunny glass-roofed arcade of honey stone with a colorful mosaic floor, potted plants and little shop fronts. Monsieur Verbe hugs his little lost dog; points to a spot on a big wall map; holds up the big golden key of the little shop he has just founded; and, in a gold beret, pulls the cloth off a bronze horse statue by the stairs. The big stone archway on the left leads out to the sunny village square. The narrow arched passage in the middle, the glazed shop doors under the red board and the stone stairway on the right lead on.

doors.label: Allée des Cadeaux
doors.hint: Through the arched passage between the shops

cadeaux.name: Allée des Cadeaux
cadeaux.alt: A cozy little gift shop in the arcade with shelves of wrapped presents, a small skylight and a round wooden package chute in the wall. Monsieur Verbe kneels to offer a present with a red ribbon in a gold beret; nods behind the counter holding up the coin he has accepted; climbs a step-stool to take down a golden trophy in a gold beret; and shows off his toy box with a drum, a trumpet and tin soldiers in a gold beret. The stone archway on the left leads back to the arcade; the open glazed door on the right leads to the next shop.

coffres.name: Rue des Coffres
coffres.alt: A cozy keepsake shop full of wooden treasure chests, hatboxes and jars of jam, with a little café table. Monsieur Verbe carries a wobbly tower of hatboxes in a gold beret; sits at the café table propping up a blank card; jingles a big ring of iron keys; and lines up his jars of jam. The open glazed door on the left leads back to the arcade.

doors.label: Rue des Trouvailles
doors.hint: Back through the open glazed door

troc.name: Place du Troc
troc.alt: A sunny rooftop swap market on top of the arcade, beside its curved glass roof, with bunting, potted trees and a view over the village. Monsieur Verbe locks a little iron safe; swaps his battered top hat for a new one at the hat stand; leads a line of ducklings across the terrace; swaps umbrellas at the umbrella stand; holds out a red apple to you; and, in a gold beret, holds back his eager dog on its lead. The stone stairway on the left leads back down to the arcade.
